nl_Literal_translation_en: From 5 to 20 seconds from now, the ego vehicle speed shall remain below 5 kilometers per hour.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 5 秒到第 20 秒之间，自车速度应始终低于 5 千米每小时。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the parking interval from the fifth through the twentieth second, the vehicle shall continuously remain below 5 km/h.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 5 秒至第 20 秒的泊车区间内，车辆速度应持续低于 5 千米每小时。
